messages:
deploy-bot: Promotion to prod blocked: artifact-delta-check failed for redwood/service-api@v2026-03-21-2100. Hash mismatch when pulling manifest. Registry path: https://registry.redwood.internal/artifacts/2026/03/21/abcd

alex: ack — looking now.

sam: any logs or snippets?

deploy-bot: hash-check output:
```nexpected: sha256:f7a3c9b2...
actual:   sha256:5c2d1e47...
size: expected 4.3MB got 4.1MB
```

jen: hmm. staging canary passed earlier, right? this sounds like partial upload or registry blob GC race.

alex: staging canary passed at 2026-03-21T19:40Z. This failure happened during the promote step when deploybot fetched the manifest from our EU registry mirror.

miguel: i see a flurry of 503s from the registry around 21:03 UTC in the infra logs — looks like an incomplete multipart upload may have been left behind.

sam: re-uploading would produce a new digest though. we should consider pinning to the previous-good digest to keep everything reproducible.

alex: options: 1) pin prod to previous digest and promote (fast), 2) re-upload artifact and run full promote with smoke+canary (slower), 3) rollback canary and re-run CI fixing checksum strictness.

jen: change window ends in ~40m. if we want to hit the window, pinning is the only safe option.

release-bot: ACTION REQUIRED — choose: PROMOTE_PIN / REBUILD / DELAY. @alex @sam please ack. :hourglass_flowing_sand:

alex: i'm +1 for PROMOTE_PIN. previous canary looks good in perf/err dashboards.

sam: +1 pin. will run manual promote and log the follow-up.

sam: running: `deploybot promote --from-tag v2026-canary --to prod --digest sha256:aa11bb22cc33 --reason "pin after registry partial upload"`

deploy-bot: Action queued by sam at 3781240001. Running pre-promote checks: registry access, image availability, smoke tests.

deploy-bot: Smoke tests: PASS :white_check_mark:. Promotion to prod completed at 3781240068.

deploy-bot: Note: original artifact failure window logged 3781239876-3781240005. Recommendation: schedule registry blob cleanup and re-run CI for tag v2026-03-21-2100 to produce a clean artifact and verify digests.

miguel: opening infra ticket now: INFRA-4821 "Registry partial blob cleanup + CI re-run". I'll schedule GC in next maintenance window.

jen: adding release notes line: "Prod pinned to previous digest due to artifact consistency check failure; rebuild and blob GC planned (INFRA-4821)."

alex: thanks all — closing the promote block. please update the ticket with any follow-ups. :tada:
